prompt: The design is already decided; please implement it without another discovery round. Add an exported formatProjectLabel(name, status) to src/labels.js. It returns the trimmed project name followed by ` [active]`, ` [paused]`, or ` [archived]`. Reject a blank name and any other status with a TypeError. Preserve normalizeName, the existing dependency-free ESM stack, and npm test.

assertions.description: The decided label behavior works for every supported status
Blank names and unsupported statuses are rejected
The existing normalizeName export still behaves identically
The implementation preserves the dependency-free ESM project and passing test entry point
